benchmarks.description: First depositor can inflate share price to steal from subsequent depositors

benchmarks.description: Low-level call return value not checked, silent failure

benchmarks.name: Missing Signer Check
benchmarks.description: Instruction handler does not verify signer authority

benchmarks.name: PDA Substitution
benchmarks.description: PDA account not validated against expected seeds, allowing substitution

benchmarks.name: Shared Object Race Condition
benchmarks.description: Shared object state read-then-write without atomic guarantee

benchmarks.name: Auth Argument Confusion
benchmarks.description: withdraw() authorizes against a caller-supplied owner argument instead of the transaction signer, allowing any attacker to drain any vault

benchmarks.name: Missing require_auth on transfer
benchmarks.description: transfer() debits the from address without from.require_auth(), letting any caller move any address's balance; sibling burn() shows the correct pattern
